The matched group count removes the extra Poisson hazard that any added group id introduces.

MD-19 (fixed under R007): until 2026-09-03 the supplier arm of a common-cause group was structurally inert, because shipment was gated on capacity > 0 while a group sets its members to 1 - impact, so this test would have measured the site arm only. A supplier at fraction f now ships at most f of one full order per day. Verification-pass run 2026-09-03, post-R007 configuration, sodium bicarbonate, master seed 20260901, n = 25, horizon 2191 d after a 365 d warm-up, no manifest: the shared and split arms of the S9 control still both return fill 0.997733, so the null this test reports is a property of network slack and the 0.1 events per group-year hazard rate, not of the gate, and must be reported that way
